aggregation_rule: Only canonical_samples contribute to formal compatibility counters; superseded, candidate-only, synthetic, and historical evidence is excluded.

observation_window.start_rule: Start at the first newly authorized real workload after this contract is published on the merged release pair; pre-contract release-boundary bundles remain provenance and do not become the window denominator.
observation_window.close_rule: Close only after the minimum duration and both backend minima are met, every authorized attempt has a terminal classification, required recovery/cancel/retention scenarios are observed, and all hard thresholds below pass.

denominator.attempted: Every newly authorized real published-pair workload with an immutable evidence bundle, including a failed or uncertain attempt; candidate-only, synthetic, historical, direct-producer, mock, and incomplete bundles are excluded from the stable sample counters.
denominator.submitted: An attempt whose JobDesk submit boundary dispatched at least one task or recorded a documented typed submission failure.
denominator.terminal: An attempt with a persisted completed, failed, cancelled, or typed fail-closed terminal outcome; unclassified attempts keep the window open.
denominator.fallback: Record requested backend, selected backend, fallback_used, and reason for every attempt; expected rollback probes and unexpected selected-control-to-legacy fallback are separate counters.

period_metric_contract.success_definition: An eligible completed success is a real published-pair workload with verified producer/consumer provenance, terminal completed state, complete required lifecycle evidence, exact cleanup proof, and independent index promotion; failed, cancelled, uncertain, candidate-only, synthetic, historical, direct-producer, mock, and incomplete bundles do not satisfy this count.
period_metric_contract.phase_f_closeout: phase_f_ready remains false until status is CLOSED, both backend minimum_eligible_completed_successes and all hard thresholds pass, legacy usage at close is measured, the retention/removal decision is recorded, and an independent review promotes only eligible bundles. Any failed, cancelled, or uncertain attempt blocks close and requires a newly authorized replacement window after review.
